title: Low-Energy Round-Trip Trajectories to Near-Earth Objects using Low Thrust
summary: Near-Earth Objects (NEOs) are attractive exploration targets due to their accessibility, scientific value, and resources. Although trajectory design has revealed efficient pathways to these bodies, systematic strategies for Earth-NEO transfers, especially with low thrust, remain limited. This work presents a streamlined methodology that blends the Sun-Earth circular restricted three-body problem (CR3BP) with the heliocentric two-body problem (2BP) to design low-energy round-trip trajectories. The current planar implementation enables efficient large-scale exploration of near-Earth space.…
